voice.ref_text: This is Market Claim Verifier. Paste a finance post, and every number is checked against the company's own SEC filings, with a link to the exact line that proves it.

scenes.narration: DappGo existed before this hackathon. Everything here was built from October 27 to November 4.

cue_events.narration: Everything here was built from October 27 to November 4.

scenes.narration: A finance post goes viral. Thousands repost it. Is it right? This one has a real number — and the wrong period. Numbers like this move money, and wrong numbers lose it.

cue_events.narration: This one has a real number — and the wrong period.
Numbers like this move money, and wrong numbers lose it.

scenes.narration: And it's not just text. Screenshots, PDFs, podcasts, videos — numbers everywhere. How do you check all of them?

cue_events.narration: How do you check all of them?

scenes.narration: Asking a model directly gets one in five right. Give the same model SEC evidence, and let a program decide: nine in ten — on held-out claims, 240 of 266.

cue_events.narration: Asking a model directly gets one in five right.
Give the same model SEC evidence, and let a program decide:

scenes.narration: Meta's Muse Spark extracts each claim and picks the SEC lookup. Python does the arithmetic and returns the verdict. Model proposes; program decides.

cue_events.narration: Meta's Muse Spark extracts each claim and picks the SEC lookup.
Python does the arithmetic and returns the verdict.

scenes.narration: Live, on the site. Paste the post. Muse Spark calls the SEC tools. Contradicted, with the filing. And here is the corrected draft. Apple's annual revenue was $416.2 billion; the quarter was $102.5 billion. Every SEC call is on the record. You can see each call. The program's verdict. Cost and time, on the receipt.

cue_events.narration: Muse Spark calls the SEC tools.
And here is the corrected draft.
Apple's annual revenue was $416.2 billion; the quarter was $102.5 billion.
Every SEC call is on the record.
Cost and time, on the receipt.

scenes.narration: The same checks run in batch from the command line — text, screenshots through Muse OCR, audio through Muse Voice Transcribe. On saved Threads posts, the median was 6.8 seconds. At that median, a thousand posts take about two hours on one worker.

scenes.narration: Ninety point two percent on held-out claims. It wrongly says 'supported' once in 139. Two cents and ten seconds a claim. On real posts, coverage is reported separately from accuracy.
